statement: ∀ (K : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] [CharZero K] (r : K), r^14=(29:K) → 0 < ‖r‖ → ‖r‖<1 → (∀ n : ℕ, 0<n → ‖(n:K)‖ = ‖r‖^(14*multiplicity 29 n)) → ∀ x : K, ‖x‖ ≤ ‖r‖ → ‖(∑' k : ℕ, (-1:K)^k*((29:K)*x)^(k+1)/((k+1:ℕ):K))/(29:K)-x‖ ≤ ‖r‖^4
